quantification.why: Nearly every comparison carries a computed figure — e.g. Sprocket's $1,130.50 is 'under 16% of revenue' and West is 'about 35% behind North.'

specificity.why: Each recommendation names a product and cites figures, e.g. 'Investigate West: 7 orders yielded $1,414.82... with only $299.00 of Gadget revenue versus North's $747.50.'

insight_density.why: It surfaces multiple actionable observations such as mean/median proximity ruling out order distortion, Sprocket's high-volume low-revenue mismatch, and West's shortfall traced to Gadget product mix ($299.00 vs $747.50).
